message: 卒業生
Between the Holy Night Festival less than a month away, the movements of the demons, and Re-Crea, both the Student Council and the Crusaders have their hands full today too.
As I am about to head from the entranceway toward the old school building, I suddenly spot a familiar face at the top of the stairs.
It's Misasagi-senpai.
She's a little too far away to call out to. I try to catch her eye and greet her, but... something is off.
Misasagi-senpai hasn't noticed me. In fact, she probably can't see anyone at all. For whatever reason, she is slowly walking down the stairs with her eyelids closed.
Watch out! I know I ought to raise my voice and warn her, yet I can't.
Looking at Misasagi-senpai's serene expression, it feels presumptuous of me to intrude.
Just in case, I brace myself at the foot of the stairs. Even if she misses a step, I should be able to catch her from here.
At the same time, though, I believe without a doubt that my worries will prove entirely unfounded.
Taking the stairs one step at a time, Misasagi-senpai shows not a trace of uncertainty, radiating a sense of calm assurance.
At last, as though nothing were out of the ordinary, she reaches the first floor, right beside me.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nineteen steps, committed to memory... I can walk right down them now even with my eyes shut, or my mind wandering elsewhere...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misasagi-senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, Mr. President. Were you watching? Good day to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hello.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「How time flies, doesn't it? November is already coming to an end.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, once December arrives--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm quite looking forward to seeing how everyone on the Student Council will put together the graduation ceremony, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! Oh, right...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I have the Wagashi Club to attend, so please excuse me.」
Misasagi-senpai gives a light bow and walks off toward Prier.
Caught off guard by the word "graduation," I am so taken aback that I forget to return her bow.
Imitating Misasagi-senpai, I close my eyes too.
Will this world be struck by Re-Crea before graduation, or after?
Picturing that moment in my mind, I try climbing the stairs.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa?!」
Before I've even made it up three steps, I trip.
A year from today, I wonder if I'll be able to walk down those stairs the way Misasagi-senpai did.
